trace_policy.basis: Same drain policy both arms; no-dump means no AEC PCM export. Drain before and after each synchronous export, otherwise every15s. Any overwritten/missing trace invalidates inference.
trace_policy.burst: Count every consecutive Render PLC/Zero missing run of at least4 slots once at the fourth slot. Later Ingress witnesses classify late versus unresolved diagnostically; neither attribution nor genuine loss invalidates covered runs.

noise_gate.policy: Coordinator step-9-coordinator-decisions-3, option (a): v3 filters each quiet window and settled baseline independently with the declared fourth-order Butterworth 100 Hz high-pass. Reference the +6 dB rise rule to max(filtered baseline, -61 dBFS), restoring the effective -55 dBFS RMS ceiling; absolute -55 and maximum20ms -46 limits unchanged. Two lifetime re-attempts and three-distinct-consecutive pause unchanged. Preserve full-band and MIC1/MIC3 low-pass100 diagnostics. MIC1-only low-frequency component has unresolved, silence-dependent origin; MIC3 is clean. Campaign-01 verdicts immutable; no old cells reused or performance retries.

bot_config.meaning_of_null_override: Unset: capability controls full duplex. Record resolved full-duplex=true; no experimental override for acceptance.

timing_policy: Each block starts after its before wifi-observe/wifi-stats/PERF. TTS at absolute block offsets0,60,120,180,240s, max request lateness1s; record actual lateness without shifting cadence, completion deadline40s. Start no export after300s; an in-flight <=25s export finishes before next block. Rates use actual PERF device duration. Same trace drain policy in both arms; trace exports are separately recorded.
baseline_policy: Settled 6.1s baseline captured once before connect; dump blocks re-export exactly that unchanged PCM/timing; no aec-record during the experiment.
safety: Existing BenchHold per-hold flock spans candidate flash through normal hash-verified restore and mixer restore. SIGINT/SIGTERM cancels host stimulus worker then follows cleanup; failure to verify normal restore retains lock. No acceptance loss/burst gate stops this diagnostic experiment; device/resource/liveness/RF/observer integrity failures stop and restore.
measurement_limit: Matched existing arrival trace changes PSRAM and console load; no-dump means no bulk AEC export. The traced base rate is comparable within this soak, not directly to untraced campaigns01-03. Trace ring8192 x32B at approximately293 records/s fills in approximately28s. Idle drain15s uses approximately4400 records; max drain gap25s leaves approximately10% margin. Any overflow, missing ticks, generation change or counter mismatch invalidates trace coverage. Every covered missing run>=4 slots counts; late/unresolved attribution is diagnostic only.

wifi_observation_policy.coverage: Last approximately256s per300s block; retain both boundary rings and report observed BSSID changes and uncovered gaps. A roam and return entirely in a gap can remain unseen.
